escalations.title: Handlebars.js JavaScript Injection — CVSS 9.8
escalations.summary: handlebars@<4.7.9 (transitive via ts-jest) carries RCE vectors via AST type confusion and prototype pollution. Multiple CVEs including GHSA-2w6w-674q-4c4q (CVSS 9.8).
escalations.remediation: cd Source/Backend && npm update ts-jest handlebars

backlog.title: Missing GET /api/search route — 5 tests FAIL on every CI run
backlog.detail: Route not registered in app.ts; no routes/search.ts exists. Test file at tests/routes/search.test.ts documents the full contract and explicitly states these tests will FAIL.
backlog.recommendation: Create Source/Backend/src/routes/search.ts implementing GET /api/search?q= (filter non-deleted work items, return {data: WorkItem[]}). Register with app.use('/api', searchRouter). Tests already define the contract.

backlog.title: dependencyCheckDuration histogram missing from metrics.ts
backlog.detail: 3 of 4 required Prometheus metrics implemented; dependencyCheckDuration Histogram absent. Also not tested in metrics.test.ts — gap is hidden.
backlog.recommendation: Add Histogram export to metrics.ts, instrument in dependency.ts around isReady()/computeHasUnresolvedBlockers(), add assertion to metrics.test.ts.

backlog.title: blocked_by field missing from portal UpdateBugInput/UpdateFeatureRequestInput; forces as any casts
backlog.detail: Lines 32 and 59 of portal/Shared/api.ts lack blocked_by?: string[]. DependencyPicker.tsx lines 291/293 use 'as any' to work around missing types, violating shared-types architecture rule.
backlog.recommendation: Add blocked_by?: string[] to both interfaces in portal/Shared/api.ts. Remove as any casts in DependencyPicker.tsx.
backlog.cross_ref_note: QO-003 + QO-004 share root cause: incomplete dependency feature. One PR closes both.

backlog.title: FR-dependency-seed: no seed.ts — dependency relationships not seeded
backlog.detail: portal/Backend/src/database/ contains only connection.ts and schema.ts. No seed.ts exists. Spec requires idempotent seed function creating 4+ known dependency relationships on startup.
backlog.recommendation: Create portal/Backend/src/database/seed.ts with idempotent insert logic (BUG-0010 blocked_by BUG-0003/0004/0005/0006/0007; FR-0004 blocked_by FR-0003; etc). Call from server startup after schema migration. Add // Verifies: FR-dependency-seed comment.
backlog.cross_ref_note: QO-003 + QO-004 share root cause: incomplete dependency feature. One PR closes both.

backlog.title: Traceability enforcer blind spot: does not scan portal/
backlog.detail: source_dirs at line 78 only includes ['Source', 'E2E']. The dev-workflow-platform app in portal/ is invisible. Default invocation auto-selects most-recently-modified plan — fragile.
backlog.recommendation: Add 'portal' to source_dirs in traceability-enforcer.py. Update CLAUDE.md verification gates to use --plan flag explicitly. Update inspector.config.yml source.dirs to include portal/.
backlog.cross_ref_note: QO-005 + QO-006 share root cause: incomplete traceability tooling setup.

backlog.title: brace-expansion <1.1.13 DoS in backend test runner
backlog.detail: CVE GHSA-f886-m6hf-6m8v (CVSS 6.5). Zero-step sequences like {1..0} cause infinite loop in brace-expansion parser. Transitive via jest -> glob. Hangs test runner if processing malformed file paths.
backlog.recommendation: cd Source/Backend && npm update brace-expansion. Run in same PR as DEP-001.
backlog.cross_ref_note: DEP-001 + DEP-002 both in Source/Backend test toolchain — one npm update pass resolves both.

backlog.title: FR-TMP-001..010 have no requirements.md and no // Verifies: comments
backlog.detail: Tiered merge pipeline spec defines 10 FRs. No requirements.md exists; no Verifies comments in any source directory. Implementation likely in platform/ but fully untraceable.
backlog.recommendation: Create Plans/tiered-merge-pipeline/requirements.md with FR-TMP-001..010. Add // Verifies: FR-TMP-XXX comments to platform/ source files.

backlog.title: Duplicate divergent test files in Source/Frontend/tests/ and tests/pages/
backlog.detail: 4 test files exist in two locations with different content: WorkItemDetailPage.test.tsx (368 vs 393 lines), WorkItemListPage.test.tsx (286 vs 262 lines). Both discovered and run by Vitest. Divergent coverage creates regression blind spots.
backlog.recommendation: Consolidate into tests/pages/ (canonical per config). Merge unique cases. Delete root-level duplicates.

backlog.title: eslint-disable suppressions for react-hooks/exhaustive-deps in production code
backlog.detail: Source/Frontend/src/components/DependencyPicker.tsx:82 and Source/Frontend/src/hooks/useWorkItems.ts:63 suppress exhaustive-deps warnings. Can mask stale-closure bugs in async React code.
backlog.recommendation: Fix the underlying hook dependency issues (add missing deps or use useCallback/useRef). Do not suppress the warning.

backlog.title: Silent catch on JSON parse failure in API client masks error context
backlog.detail: Line 26: const body = await response.json().catch(() => ({})). Silently replaces HTML 502 or malformed error body with {}. Violates 'Never swallow errors silently' architecture rule.
backlog.recommendation: Add console.warn (or logger in dev mode): .catch((e) => { console.warn('Failed to parse error response', e); return {}; })

backlog.title: Vite <=6.4.1 path traversal, esbuild CORS bypass, postcss XSS — dev-only
backlog.detail: GHSA-4w7w-66w2-5vf9 (vite path traversal), GHSA-67mh-4wv8-2f99 (esbuild CORS), GHSA-qx2v-qp2m-jg93 (postcss XSS). All in dev dependencies, not shipped to production.
backlog.recommendation: cd Source/Frontend && npm update vite vitest. Requires vite 5.x -> 8.x major bump; plan regression testing.

backlog.title: React 18 -> 19, react-router-dom 6 -> 7 — version lag
backlog.detail: react@18.3.1 (latest: 19.2.6), react-dom@18.3.1, react-router-dom@6.30.3 (latest: 7.15.0). Missing compiler optimizations and new features. Not a security risk.
backlog.recommendation: Plan React 19 migration with regression testing.

backlog.title: Express 4 -> 5, Pino 8 -> 10, uuid 9 -> 14 — version lag
backlog.detail: express@4.22.1 (latest: 5.2.1), pino@8.21.0 (latest: 10.3.1), uuid@9.0.1 (latest: 14.0.0). Quality/perf improvements. Not security-critical.
backlog.recommendation: Plan incremental major-version upgrades with compatibility testing.

backlog.title: 4 portal files exceed 500 lines (tech debt)
backlog.detail: FeatureRequestDetail.tsx (550 lines), BugDetail.tsx (546 lines), cycleService.ts (526 lines), featureRequestService.ts (506 lines). Mix multiple concerns.
backlog.recommendation: Track as tech debt. On next touch, extract sub-components/helpers.

backlog.title: Deprecated packages: glob (old), async-cache, superagent@8, supertest@6
backlog.detail: async-cache@1.0.6 'leaks memory, do not use'; glob old versions 'contain publicized security vulnerabilities'; superagent@8.1.2 'upgrade to 10.2.2+'; supertest@6.3.4 'upgrade to 7.1.3+'.
